wf411a4_supplementary_verifier.task_brief: m6_kappa Tier-2 supplementary verifier (per-cohort empirical check)
wf411a4_supplementary_verifier.description: Wf-411-A4 verifies the Wf-389-A1 §3 supplementary sub-table recommendation (MolLogP + MorganDensity_r2 + Chi3v as supplementary alternatives to m6_kappa) at the per-cohort level. Per Wf-411-A4 task brief + Wf-389-A1 §3: split n=5460 MetalCytoToxDB into 5 cohorts (NSCLC + breast + melanoma + Krebs + other), compute per-cohort Pearson r for each invariant, classify per Cohen 1988 3-band scheme (|r| < 0.1 WEAK / 0.1-0.5 MODERATE / >= 0.5 STRONG). The empirical finding is a STRUCTURAL REFINEMENT of Wf-389-A1 §3: 13/15 cohort-cells are MODERATE (|r| >= 0.1) on the 3-band scheme (vs the Wf-389-A1 §3 verdict using a 4-band scheme where 0.1-0.3 was called WEAK). 0 STRONG bands. Aggregate verdict = MIXED. The supplementary sub-table is exploratory + mostly MODERATE per the 3-band Cohen 1988 scheme, not pure WEAK. This is an HONEST-NEGATIVE refinement.
wf411a4_supplementary_verifier.interpretation: Per Wf-411-A4 3-band Cohen 1988 scheme, the supplementary sub-table (MolLogP + MorganDensity_r2 + Chi3v) reaches MODERATE band (|r| >= 0.1) in 13/15 cohort-cells and WEAK band (|r| < 0.1) in 2/15 cohort-cells. No STRONG bands (|r| >= 0.5). This is a REFINEMENT of the Wf-389-A1 §3 verdict (which labeled these as WEAK under a 4-band scheme). The supplementary sub-table remains valid per Wf-389-A1 §3 but is best described as exploratory + mostly MODERATE per the 3-band Cohen 1988 scheme.

Per §6 honest-limitations framing per AGENTS.md §5.2 + Wf-371-A1 §3.5 + Wf-375-A4 §3, m6_kappa is retained as a complementary heuristic in §6 honest-limitations.
